steps.title: Load and run Docker image
steps.instruction: Load the provided Docker image tarball and start a Jupyter Lab server inside the container.

substeps.instruction: Load the Docker image from the supplied archive: `docker load < DockerImage_10.55458_NeuroLibre_00019_0f9c84.tar.gz`. The image was built from the reference repository/commit by roboneuro, based on the latest author change, using repo2docker (through BinderHub).

Run the image, exposing port 8888 and launching Jupyter Lab: `docker run -it --rm -p 8888:8888 DOCKER_IMAGE_ID jupyter lab --ip 0.0.0.0`. Replace **DOCKER_IMAGE_ID** with the ID shown after the `docker load` step.
